project.description: EnableTestBeans documents that @TestBean is collected from the test class or one of its superclasses, directly or via meta-annotation, and a shared test base class is the reason that rule exists. Scenario 13 pins the annotation on the test class itself and scenario 17 pins the meta-annotation form; this one pins the inheritance path, so a base class can activate an alternative for every subclass without each of them repeating the declaration.
project.name: jawelte tests/cdi-module scenario 66: a @TestBean declared on a superclass applies to the subclass
